items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: Yeah, Kaipa, me, and we had a Slime Tramble.

ctx.x: How big? Five pieces, that's all. You had Kaipa? Yeah, Kaipa, me, and we had a Slime Tramble.

And we had the drummer. Just all we had, five pieces, I can't remember who was in the band, you know? You said Charlie Love was there too. Yeah, Charlie Love was there. Kaipa, no, no, Charlie Love wasn't. Willie Pajot. Oh. I was on the road with Willie Pajot and Charlie Love. Yeah, that was another time. That was another time, yeah. We went to Donison, not Donisonville. One of them little country towns there. We stayed at, on Narrow Street, the 16-hundred block. And we played a couple of jobs and I said, well…
